note: Placeholder biomechanics rules and correlations removed from Supabase on 2026-11-06. None were derived from the research data: thresholds never fired (sway gap > 1.5 when tour values are -9.8 to -4.6) or fired for everyone (pelvis sway > 2 when tour values are 3.1 to 7.9; lead elbow > 20 when the site measures 148-168 degrees).

rules.notes: Excessive pelvis sway tends to correlate with over-the-top delivery and cut path.
rules.test_tip: Confirm club path data. If path is out-to-in draw-bias head may help.

rules.recommendation: Higher launch shaft. Check dynamic loft.
rules.notes: Chest lift into impact often reduces dynamic loft.
rules.test_tip: Check dynamic loft on launch monitor. Target 2-3° above attack angle.

bio_correlations.notes: Large sway gap correlates with inconsistent strike pattern.
Lead elbow bend at impact tends to reduce dynamic loft.

bio_correlations.shaft_profile: Mid kick point, stable butt section
bio_correlations.notes: Pelvis sway often correlates with path issues.
